answers.evidence: [p001 00:00]-[p004 00:07] The first four lines put us in a concrete moment: a cold day, 小問 in the park photographing squirrels with mom's old phone, and it blacks out the instant she presses the shutter. That is a person doing a thing in a place, not a topic intro or a preview.

[p011 00:27] gives only 'the battery is old', which the title already says. [p015 00:40] and [p016 00:44] tease 'a reason you would not expect' and 'a layer growing inside' and stop before either result. The real answers (the scale layer at p051, the narrowed spout at p098, the phone shutting itself off to protect its parts at p115) are not stated in chapter 1.

[p021]-[p180] The story moves forward in one line: the percentage is just a full jug (ch2), the scale layer shrinks the jug (ch3), the narrowed spout causes the blackout (ch4), how to slow aging and what to do about mom's phone (ch5), then 小問 solves the case (ch6). No section goes back and retells an earlier one; returns such as p121 and p160 are marked callbacks.

[p018 00:52] '我們打開這顆老電池看看' and [p021 01:03] '先想想你每天帶的水壺' are invitations inside the story, not announcements of the video's structure. No line says 接下來, 先講 or 第一…第二…, and no line lists upcoming content. [p140 07:09] '等一下也有辦法' is a forward hook about mom's phone, which question 4 allows.

[p021 01:03] '要回答它' picks up the p019-p020 question. [p051 02:34] answers p049-p050 '壺怎麼會自己變小'. [p098 05:03] answers p096-p097 '怎麼會一下子黑掉'. [p139 07:05] answers p137-p138 '怎麼讓電池老得慢一點'. [p171 08:46] answers p169-p170 '公園裡手機到底發生什麼事'.

[p015 00:40] and [p016 00:44] open hooks that are still unanswered at 2:34 and 5:56. After that a new question opens well inside every 90 seconds: p031 1:31, p043 2:10, p049 2:30, p064 3:18, p073 3:43, p085 4:20, p096 4:58, p106 5:33, p119 6:07, p131 6:45, p137 7:00, p140 7:09 (forward hook about mom's phone), p154 7:55, p162 8:19 and p169 8:41.

[p016]->[p051] the layer growing inside is named as 水垢. [p015]->[p097]/[p115] the 'unexpected reason' comes back through the named question '怎麼會一下子黑掉' and is answered by the phone shutting itself off. [p008]->[p118] '多半沒有壞'. [p140]->[p162]-[p167] mom's phone is named again and the answer is to have the battery replaced. [p120]->[p122]. All adjacent questions are answered directly.

[p176 09:02] '它多半是在保護自己' is the third time the script says this (after [p116 05:59] '保護裡面的零件' and [p174 08:55] '保護自己'), with no callback marker on the last one. [p135 06:56]-[p136] already apply the narrow spout plus the cold to the park blackout, so [p172]-[p174] state that same conclusion a second time. [p126 06:30] restates what 小問 just said in [p124]-[p125].

[p001] '還有電，手機卻黑掉了', [p021] '百分之百，只是這個壺裝滿了', [p051] '電池裡長出一層水垢', [p098] '壺嘴變窄，大口倒不出來', [p139] '手機先停在八成' and [p171] '小問自己破案' each name something that happens or is revealed. None is a function label such as background or conclusion.
[p178 09:08]-[p180 09:14] The outro asks viewers whether their phone has ever blacked out, asks them to comment and to subscribe. It never mentions a next video, episode or file.

[p012 00:31]-[p013] ask how a battery can be old when it still has charge. [p015 00:40] promises 'a reason you would not expect' for the blackout. [p016 00:44] says a layer is secretly growing inside the battery. [p018 00:52] invites us to open the old battery. That makes at least three hooks after the first scene (p001-p008), each stopping before its answer.

[p004 00:07] Mom's old phone blacking out in the park with 20% left is carried through every chapter: the percentage only measures fullness (ch2), the scale shrinks the jug (ch3), the narrowed spout plus the cold causes the shutdown (ch4, p135), how to keep the battery healthy and what to do with mom's phone (ch5, p162), and 小問 solves the park blackout (ch6, p172).

[p070 03:30]-[p084 04:17] The cycle-count section (1000 cycles, about 80%, nearly three years) and the heat and cold section [p087]-[p095] both answer 小問's own questions about how the jug shrinks, and the heat and cold points are used again at p133 and p160. There is no list of products, scores or who said what; the single company claim is attributed once at p074.

[p022 01:06] The jug metaphor is set up before it is used. 最大容量 is explained at [p041], 一次循環 at [p071], 水垢 at [p053]-[p054] and [p056], and 壺嘴 at [p099]. Every reply answers the line just before it, e.g. p113->p115, p127->p129, p147->p148. 'Pours with force' at [p047] is picked up at [p129].
